role: Independent verifier; did not collect the research anchors or fit the submitted benchmark.
resolved_findings: PAS_CRD described as on-flight airport-pair flow, distinct from PAS_BRD and full journeys.
Median-factor formula corrected for the exact even-sample implementation.
Selection now describes complete positive monthly observations, not all possible new/closed routes.
Optional covariate term is distinguished from the distance definition.
limits: Observed annual routes with twelve positive months; no zero-flow/absent-pair or monthly-seasonality validation.
National/regional proxies, partial training airport masses, 2026 data vintage and NUTS2024 geometry are explicit research assumptions.
No causal effect, formal statistical significance or validation of production P/T/F is established.
Train-only smearing trades aggregate bias against route-level error; it is not a uniform improvement.
Owner modelling/publication stage remains outside this independent verification.
